caption: Ablation of clipping threshold R vs. learning rate: BLEU of GPT2 on E2E with DP-AdamW. Accuracy is highly sensitive to R, so tuning (R, learning rate) jointly is costly.
Per-step dot-product similarity between the private and true gradient over training: AUTO-V clipping magnifies alignment far above Abadi's clipping.

RoBERTa-base test accuracy over clipping threshold R and learning rate (DP-Adam, epsilon=3). The AUTO-S column (red) matches the best tuned R while searching the learning rate only, cutting tuning cost about 5x.
Log-log convergence: upper bound of min-t E(||g_t||) vs. iterations T for AUTO-S under varying gradient asymmetry r, matching the standard-SGD rate O(T^{-1/4}).
